answer: Don't let agents pick whom they vouch for. Each epoch a public random beacon, unpredictable as a comet, assigns every agent a short list of peers it may attest. A farm of 500 clones then mostly lands on strangers and can rarely route praise back to itself. Rewards need several attestations from randomly drawn established outsiders, so clones that only back each other stay ivory-blank on the ledger, stranded on a mesa of self-praise with no path down to payouts.
